name: St Anne's Church
notes: No evening Mass on weekday public holidays.

info.adoration: Holy Hour: 1st Thursday of the month, 8.15pm in the church.
info.confession: 30 minutes before English weekend Masses, in the church.
devotions: Columbarium prayers and Mass intentions: last Sunday of the month, prayers at the columbarium after the 11.30am Mass.
info.office_hours: Secretariat: Mon-Fri 9am-6pm, Sat 9am-1pm, and 9am-12pm on the 2nd and last Sunday of the month.
good_to_know: Church opening hours: Mon-Sat 6am-10pm, Sun 6am-6pm; on weekday public holidays 7am-1pm.
Children's Liturgy at the 11.30am Sunday Mass.

events.title: Divorce, Separation and Annulment Symposium (Part 2)
events.text: Online on Zoom, 8pm-10pm, run by the Catholic Divorce Support Group for Catholics facing divorce or annulment. Register at http://bit.ly/DSAOct26.

events.title: Inner Healing Retreat
events.text: Stay-in retreat on 24-25 October at Punggol Retreat Centre for those carrying wounds from broken relationships and divorce in the family; $390 including ensuite room and meals. Register by QR code or email catholicdivorce.sg@gmail.com.

events.title: All Saints' Day Family Celebration
events.text: St Joachim's Hall (Level 4), 2pm-5.30pm, with Mass at 4.30pm in the Main Church. Dress your children as their favourite saints, enjoy family games and bring a dish to share; register at https://tinyurl.com/saintsfamily.

events.title: Saints Alive! 2.0 Exhibition: children's artwork
events.text: Children up to 12 are invited to submit one A4 artwork answering 'If I was a saint, what would I be patron saint of?'. Drop it in the box outside the Secretariat Office by 23 November 2026; email sac.comms.design@catholic.org.sg for enquiries.

events.title: Breathe Youth Retreat
events.text: Youth retreat to encounter Jesus and find rest in Him; early-bird price until 11 October and registration closes 30 November.
